desc: Superior cutting structure designed to reduce drag and use lower torque pressures downhole

Integrated tab connection to reduce overall reamer length and efficient product installation
Nozzles facing the cutters and center opening improve productivity and efficiency

Option to trail pipe reducing time and cost on the jobsite when needed.

Nozzles facing the cutters and center opening to improve productivity and efficiencies.
